integrity: The proof exhausts the translated-edge intersections after a dihedral reduction, derives three exact branches, and bounds each of the two midline lengths separately. A common sharp pair attains both bounds. The bundled finite checker is supplementary and is not used as proof of the continuum statement. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the regular octagonal Banach plane and does not classify all maximizing equilateral pairs or extend the coordinatewise envelope to arbitrary regular polygons.
title: Sharp two-midline envelope on the regular octagonal Banach plane
